Meet Jaime

I Value People First.
I Build Relationships.
I Create What Doesn't Exist Yet.

I am a Human Cultural Integrator and Strategic Workforce Builder — and no box has ever been built that can hold me. I operate at the intersection of human culture, relationships, and workforce development. My mission is to cultivate sustainable ecosystems where people, businesses, schools, and communities thrive together — not just economically, but humanly.

I lead with people first — always. I am not a recruiter. I am the strategic partner who builds the human infrastructure, integrates culture, and creates the workforce pipelines that sustain entire ecosystems. I work across Advanced Manufacturing, Healthcare, Education, Government, and Small Business — wherever people and purpose need to be connected.

"I am not a recruiter. I am a Human Cultural Integrator — a unicorn who defines systems that haven't been discovered yet. I see what others miss. I build what others can't imagine. When you cannot be at the table, I am the elite player who sits there for you."

As a non-linear thinker and author, I believe sustainable growth is not about economic metrics — it is about people. Relationships. Culture. Connection. When we put people first and integrate smart systems around them, we build ecosystems that sustain themselves — and the communities inside them.

The Work I Do

I See Your Problem.
I Build the Solution.

I don't hand you a report and leave. I sit with you, understand your ecosystem, and build the human infrastructure that solves the problem sustainably — because the real issue is almost never what you think it is on the surface.

🏢
Small Business
You are brilliant at what you do — but visibility, marketing, and community presence are not your zone. I build your brand, design your marketing materials, connect you to the right people, and embed you in the ecosystem where your business can actually grow.
Website strategy  ·  Marketing materials  ·  Community outreach  ·  Brand positioning  ·  Network integration
💙
Nonprofit & Community Orgs
As a nonprofit founder myself, I understand the weight of mission-driven work. Nonprofits are not an afterthought in my model — they are at the center of everything I build. I help nonprofits design websites, create marketing materials, plan and execute events, build sustainable partnerships, and integrate fully into the LINK Community ecosystem where they belong.
Website strategy  ·  Marketing materials  ·  Event design & support  ·  Partnership development  ·  Community Hub integration  ·  Funder strategy
🏛
Employers & Organizations
Retention is a culture problem. Hiring is a pipeline problem. Both are human problems. I build the people infrastructure — integrating culture, soft skills, workforce pipelines, and AI frameworks — so your organization stops losing what it worked so hard to build.
Culture assessment  ·  Workforce pipelines  ·  Soft skills programs  ·  AI implementation  ·  Leadership development
🎓
Schools & Education
The gap between school and workforce is not a student problem — it's a systems problem. I bring Future Ready Internships and soft skills programs directly into schools, and connect educational institutions to the employers and community partners they need to make students genuinely career-ready.
Future Ready Internships  ·  In-school soft skills  ·  Employer connections  ·  Career pathways  ·  Post-grad pipeline

Communities & Regions
A thriving community is not an accident — it is an ecosystem. I design and build the LINK Community Hub model that connects every sector into a unified, self-sustaining network. Wherever you are, this framework can be activated to transform how your community works together.
LINK Community Hub  ·  Cross-sector partnerships  ·  Sustainable ecosystem design  ·  Regional alignment

Signature Programs

Built From the Ground Up

These are not programs I found. These are programs I created — because they didn't exist yet.

Creator
Future Ready Internships

A first-of-its-kind internship framework for high school students — pairing real workforce experience with in-school soft skills training. Building the talent pipeline before students ever graduate. Designed to close the gap between education and employment at the earliest possible stage.

In Schools
Soft Skills in Schools

Professional skills — communication, collaboration, emotional intelligence, workplace readiness — delivered directly inside schools where students actually are. Not a workshop. Not a one-day event. A program woven into the fabric of school culture.

Community

Curated small-group events built for real relationships, not card swaps. Connecting professionals, business owners, and community leaders in a format that actually creates trust, opportunity, and lasting partnerships inside the LINK ecosystem.
